questions.questionText: Find the next number in the series: 14, 21, 28, 35, 42, ?
questions.explanationText: A constant 7 is added each time. Therefore, 42 + 7 = 49.
Each term is 8 less than the preceding term. Thus, the missing term is 67 - 8 = 59; also, 59 - 8 = 51.
The additions are +4, +6, +8 and +10. The next addition is +12, giving 34 + 12 = 46.

questions.questionText: Which number should replace the blank? 90, 79, 70, 63, 58, ?.
questions.explanationText: The subtractions are 11, 9, 7 and 5, decreasing by 2. Next subtract 3: 58 - 3 = 55.
The successive additions are +10, +12, +14 and +16. Hence the first term is 18 - 10 = 8.
The multipliers are 2, 3, 4 and 5. The next multiplier is 6, so 360 × 6 = 2160.
Each term is twice the previous term plus 3: 125 × 2 + 3 = 253.
Each term is three times the preceding term minus 2. Thus 55 × 3 - 2 = 163, and 163 × 3 - 2 = 487.
The operations are ×3+1, ×4+1, ×5+1 and ×6+1. Therefore, 266 × 6 + 1 = 1597.
Every term is obtained by dividing by 3. Hence 27 ÷ 3 = 9.
The terms are n(n+1) for n=1,2,3,4,5. For n=6, the term is 6×7=42.
These are consecutive squares plus 1: 3²+1=10, 4²+1=17, 5²+1=26, 6²+1=37. Thus the blank is 37.
The terms are n³-1 for n=1,2,3,4,5. The next is 6³-1=216-1=215.

questions.questionText: Find the wrong number in the series: 5, 7, 11, 15, 17, 19, 23.
questions.explanationText: All terms should be consecutive prime numbers from 5: 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23. Therefore, 15 is wrong; it should be 13.
The terms are consecutive squares: 2², 3², 4², 5², 6². The next is 7²=49.
The nth term is 3n²: 3, 12, 27, 48, 75, 108. Hence the blank is 3×4²=48.
Differences are 9, 15, 21 and 27; their constant second difference is 6. The next difference is 33, so 80+33=113.
The terms are n³+1 for n=1 to 6: 2,9,28,65,126,217. Thus the missing term is 65.
First differences are 4,10,20,34; second differences are 6,10,14, increasing by 4. Next second difference is 18, so next first difference is 52 and 69+52=121.
The differences are consecutive primes 5,11,17,23? They rise by 6 but are not consecutive primes. The intended difference progression is +5,+11,+17,+23, so next +29; 63+29=92.
Add successive primes: +2, +5, +7, +11 and +13. Thus 25+11=36 and 36+13=49.
Each term is the sum of the previous two. Hence 13+21=34.
Each term equals twice the preceding term, alternating +1 and -1: 2×2+1=5, 5×2-1=9, 9×2+1=19, 19×2-1=37. Next, 37×2+1=75.
From the third term onward, each term is the sum of the previous two plus 1: 1+2+1=4, 2+4+1=7. Thus 12+20+1=33.
Add successive squares: +1,+4,+9,+16,+25. Thus 17+16=33 and 33+25=58.
The changes are -3,+4,-5,+6,-7. Next is +8, so 45+8=53.
The changes are +5,-2,+7,-4,+9; positive changes rise by 2 and negative changes fall by 2 more. Next change is -6, giving 25-6=19.
Odd-position terms are 2,4,8,16 (doubling). Even-position terms are 10,20,40 (also doubling). Therefore, the blank is 40.
Odd positions are 81,72,63,... decreasing by 9; even positions are 3,6,9,... increasing by 3. The next odd-position term is 54.
Odd positions double: 5,10,20,40. Even positions decrease by 10: 100,90,80. Hence the blank is 80.
Odd positions double: 1,2,4,8. Even positions also double: 10,20,40, so the next even-position term is 80.
Odd positions are consecutive primes 2,3,5,7. Each even term is three times the preceding odd term. Therefore, 7×3=21.
Odd positions double: 4,8,16,32. Even positions should double: 9,18,36,72. Hence 35 is the only wrong term; it should be 36.
The operations alternate ×3 and +4. Thus, after 79 the next operation is ×3, giving 237.
A three-operation cycle repeats: +6, ×3, -3. From 105 the cycle restarts with +6, so the next term is 111.
The repeating cycle is ×3, ×2, -3. Therefore, after 51 comes 51×3=153.
The operations are ÷2,+4,÷3,+4,÷4,+4. Thus 16÷4=4 and 4+4=8.
Multiply by successive integers and add one less than the multiplier: 6×2+1=13, 13×3+2=41, 41×4+3=167. Next, 167×5+4=839.
Multiply successively by 2,3,4,5,6 and add 1 each time: 2×2+1=5, 5×3+1=16, ..., 326×6+1=1957.

questions.questionText: Find the number that replaces the blank: 48, 28, 18, 13, ?.
questions.explanationText: Each term is half the preceding term plus 4: 48÷2+4=28, 28÷2+4=18, 18÷2+4=13. Thus 13÷2+4=10.5.
Each term is increased by its own digit sum: 123+6=129, 129+12=141, 141+6=147, 147+12=159. Hence 159+(1+5+9)=174.
Add the product of the digits of the current term: 12+2=14, 14+4=18, 18+8=26, 26+12=38. Next, 38+(3×8)=62.
Subtract the absolute difference of the digits: 51-4=47, 47-3=44, and 44-0 remains 44. Therefore, the next term is 44.

The operations alternate reversing the digits and doubling: 12→21 (reverse), 21→42 (double), but the shown 24 interrupts. Instead terms pair reversals: 12,21;24,42;48,84; next 96, followed by 69. Hence 96.
Terms occur in reverse pairs. 13→31, 35→53, so the next pair must be 75→57. Therefore, the blank is 75.
Add the product of the digits: 23+6=29, 29+18=47, 47+28=75, and 75+35=110.
The intended differences are powers of 2: +4,+8,+16,+32,+64, giving 22,26,34,50,82,146. Thus 52 is the only wrong term; it should be 50.
Multiply by 2,3,4,... and then add the same multiplier? 9×2=18; +2=20; ×3=60; +3=63; ×4=252; next +4=256. The paired cycle uses ×n,+n.
Subtract decreasing integers: 9,8,7,6,5. Therefore, 76-6=70 and 70-5=65.
Odd positions are -3,-5,-7,... decreasing by 2. Even positions are 2,4,6,... increasing by 2. The next odd term is -9.
Differences are triangular numbers 3,6,10,15. The next triangular difference is 21, so 35+21=56.
The terms are oblong numbers n(n+1): 1×2? That gives2. Instead shown terms fit n(2n-1): 1,6,15,28,45,66 for n=1..6. Hence 28.
These are factorials: 1!,2!,3!,4!,5!. The next term is 6!=720.
Each term is multiplied by successive integers and then the same integer is added: 2×1+1=3, 3×2+2=8, 8×3+3=27, 27×4+4=112. Next, 112×5+5=565.

questions.questionText: Find the missing number: 6, 28, 496, ?, among the classic perfect numbers.
questions.explanationText: The series lists perfect numbers, numbers equal to the sum of their proper divisors: 6, 28, 496, 8128. Thus the missing number is 8128.
Multiply by successive integers 2,3,4,5 and then 6. Hence 360×6=2160.
Both numerator and denominator increase by 1. Therefore, after 4/5 comes 5/6.
Each term is multiplied by 2/3. Thus 4/9×2/3=8/27, and 8/27×2/3=16/81.
Divide successively by 2,3,4 and 5: 3÷2=3/2, then ÷3=1/2, then ÷4=1/8. Next, 1/8÷5=1/40.
Each term is multiplied by 3. Hence 5.4×3=16.2.
Each term is half the previous term plus 0.5: 8.4÷2+0.5=4.7, and so on. Thus 1.925÷2+0.5=1.4625.
The increments are 0.6,1.2,1.8,2.4, increasing by 0.6. Next increment is 3.0; 8.5+3.0=11.5.
These are pronic numbers n(n+1): 1×2 through 6×7. The next is 7×8=56.
Differences are 4,7,10,13,16, increasing by 3. Hence 22+13=35 and 35+16=51.
Each term is twice the previous term plus 5: 1×2+5=7, 7×2+5=19. Reversing, (7-5)÷2=1.

questions.questionText: Choose the pair that fills the blanks: 4, ?, 22, 40, ?, 94.
questions.explanationText: The differences are +6,+12,+18,+24,+30. Thus the blanks are 4+6=10 and 40+24=64.

questions.questionText: Find the correct replacement for 91 in: 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, 91.
questions.explanationText: Each term is twice the preceding term plus 1. After 63, the correct value is 63×2+1=127, so 91 should be replaced by 127.
The rule is ×2+2: 2→6→14→30→62→126. Therefore, 61 is the first incorrect term; it should be 62.
These should be consecutive cubes 1³,2³,3³,4³,5³,6³. The fifth term should be 125, so 126 is wrong.
Differences double: 4,8,16,32. The next difference is 64, so 73+64=137.
Each term is half the previous one. Thus 64÷2=32 and 32÷2=16.
Each term is twice the previous term plus 1. Therefore, 31×2+1=63.
Subtract consecutive squares: 1²,2²,3²,4². Next subtract 5²=25, so 60-25=35.
The operations alternate +2 and ×2. After 30, multiply by 2 to obtain 60.
Each term is divided by 2. Hence 125÷2=62.5.
The operations alternate ×5 and +5. Thus 150+5=155 and 155×5=775.
The operations are ×2,-2,×2,-3,×2,-4. Therefore, 42-4=38.
The operations alternate ×3 and ÷2. Thus 54÷2=27.
Each term is three times the previous term plus 1. Reversing from 10 gives (10-1)÷3=3.
After the first step, each increment doubles: +5,+10,+20,+40. Next add 80, giving 161.
Each term is multiplied by 3 and then increased by 5: 2×3+5=11, 11×3+5=38, 38×3+5=119. Next, 119×3+5=362.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: B, E, H, K, N, ?.
questions.explanationText: Each letter is three positions ahead: B(2),E(5),H(8),K(11),N(14). The next position is 17, which is Q.

questions.questionText: Find the missing letter: Z, V, R, ?, J, F.
questions.explanationText: Move backward by 4 positions each time: Z→V→R→N→J→F. Thus the missing letter is N.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: C, F, J, O, U, ?.
questions.explanationText: The forward shifts are +3,+4,+5,+6; the next is +7. U shifted 7 places wraps around to B.

questions.questionText: Find the first letter: ?, G, L, R, Y.
questions.explanationText: The forward shifts are +4,+5,+6,+7. Therefore, the first letter is four places before G, namely C.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: X, U, Q, L, F, ?.
questions.explanationText: The backward shifts are -3,-4,-5,-6. Next shift -7 from F wraps to Y.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: D, G, E, I, F, K, ?.
questions.explanationText: Odd positions are D,E,F,G, increasing by 1. Even positions are G,I,K, increasing by 2. The next odd-position letter is G.

questions.questionText: Find the missing letter: A, Z, C, X, E, ?, G.
questions.explanationText: Odd positions are A,C,E,G (+2). Even positions are Z,X,V (-2). Hence the missing letter is V.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: B, Y, E, V, H, S, ?.
questions.explanationText: Odd-position letters are B,E,H,K (+3), while even-position letters are Y,V,S (-3). The next term is K.

questions.questionText: Find the wrong letter: A, D, H, M, R, Z.
questions.explanationText: The shifts should be +3,+4,+5,+6,+7, producing A,D,H,M,S,Z. Therefore, R is wrong; it should be S.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter using alphabet positions: A, D, I, P, ?.
questions.explanationText: Positions are perfect squares 1,4,9,16. The next is 25, corresponding to Y.

questions.questionText: Find the missing letter: B, F, L, ?, D (with wrap-around).
questions.explanationText: The positions advance by +4,+6,+8,+10. B→F→L→T→D after wrap-around. Hence the blank is T.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: Z, W, S, N, H, ?.
questions.explanationText: The backward shifts are 3,4,5,6; next is 7. Moving 7 back from H reaches A.

questions.questionText: Find the next term in the vowel-consonant series: A, B, E, D, I, F, ?.
questions.explanationText: Odd positions are vowels A,E,I,O; even positions are B,D,F. Thus the next odd-position term is O.

questions.questionText: Find the missing letter: U, B, O, D, ?, F, E.
questions.explanationText: Odd positions are vowels in reverse order U,O,I,E. Even positions are B,D,F. Therefore, the missing letter is I.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: A, C, F, J, O, ?.
questions.explanationText: Forward shifts are +2,+3,+4,+5. The next shift is +6, so O→U.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: M, L, J, G, C, ?.
questions.explanationText: Backward shifts are -1,-2,-3,-4. Next is -5: C shifted back 5 places wraps to X.

questions.questionText: Find the next pair: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?.
questions.explanationText: The first letters increase A,B,C,D,E while the second decrease Z,Y,X,W,V. Hence the next pair is EV.

questions.questionText: Find the missing pair: ZA, XC, ?, TG, RI.
questions.explanationText: In each pair, the first letter moves back by 2 (Z,X,V,T,R), while the second moves forward by 2 (A,C,E,G,I). Thus the blank is VE.

questions.questionText: Find the next group: AB, DE, GH, JK, ?.
questions.explanationText: Each group contains consecutive letters, and group starts move forward by 3: A,D,G,J,M. Therefore, MN follows.

questions.questionText: Find the next group: ABC, EFG, IJK, MNO, ?.
questions.explanationText: Each group has three consecutive letters; starting letters advance by 4: A,E,I,M,Q. Hence QRS.

questions.questionText: Find the missing group: ZYX, WVU, ?, QPO.
questions.explanationText: Each group is three descending consecutive letters, and starts move back by 3: Z,W,T,Q. Thus TSR is missing.

questions.questionText: Find the next group: AB, BA, CD, DC, EF, ?.
questions.explanationText: Consecutive-letter groups occur in normal and reversed order: AB,BA; CD,DC; EF,FE. Therefore, FE follows.

questions.questionText: Find the next pair: AC, DF, GI, JL, ?.
questions.explanationText: Both letters in each pair move forward by 3. Thus J→M and L→O, giving MO.

questions.questionText: Find the missing pair: BY, DW, ?, HS.
questions.explanationText: First letters increase by 2: B,D,F,H. Second letters decrease by 2: Y,W,U,S. Hence FU.

questions.questionText: Find the next pair: AX, CV, ET, GR, ?.
questions.explanationText: The first letters advance by 2, while second letters move backward by 2. After GR comes IP.

questions.questionText: Find the next group: ABD, BCE, CDF, DEG, ?.
questions.explanationText: Each letter in the three-letter group advances by one from term to term. Thus DEG becomes EFH.

questions.questionText: Find the next group: ACE, BDF, CEG, DFH, ?.
questions.explanationText: Each column advances by one letter: A,B,C,D,E; C,D,E,F,G; E,F,G,H,I. Therefore, EGI.

questions.questionText: Find the missing group: AZ, CX, EV, ?, IR.
questions.explanationText: First letters advance by 2 (A,C,E,G,I), and second letters retreat by 2 (Z,X,V,T,R). The blank is GT.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: AA, BC, CE, DG, ?.
questions.explanationText: First letters advance by 1; second letters advance by 2: A,C,E,G,I. Hence the next group is EI.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: ZA, YC, XE, WG, ?.
questions.explanationText: First letters retreat by 1; second letters advance by 2. Therefore, W→V and G→I, giving VI.

questions.questionText: Find the wrong group: AB, DF, GJ, JP, MR.
questions.explanationText: First letters advance by 3: A,D,G,J,M. Second letters advance by 4: B,F,J,N,R. Thus JP is wrong; it should be JN.

questions.questionText: Find the correct replacement for QV: AD, DG, GJ, JM, QV.
questions.explanationText: Both letters move forward by 3 in each step: AD,DG,GJ,JM,MP. Therefore, QV should be replaced by MP.

questions.questionText: Find the next pair: AB, CE, FI, JM, ?.
questions.explanationText: First-letter shifts are +2,+3,+4, so next +5 gives O. Second-letter shifts are +3,+4,+5, so next +6 gives S. Hence OS.

questions.questionText: Find the next group: AAA, BCD, CEG, DGI, ?.
questions.explanationText: The first letter advances by 1, the second by 2, and the third by 3 in each term. Thus DGI becomes EIK.

questions.questionText: Find the missing term: ZYX, XVU, ?, TPO.
questions.explanationText: In each column letters move back by 2: first Z,X,V,T; second Y,V,S,P; third X,U,R,O. Hence VSR.

questions.questionText: Find the next group: ABC, BDF, CEI, ?.
questions.explanationText: The first, second and third letters advance by 1, 2 and 3 respectively. Thus C→D, F→H and I→L, giving DHL.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: A, Z, D, W, G, T, ?.
questions.explanationText: Odd positions move forward by 3: A,D,G,J. Even positions move backward by 3: Z,W,T. Hence J.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: C, X, F, U, I, R, ?.
questions.explanationText: Odd terms C,F,I,L increase by 3; even terms X,U,R decrease by 3. Therefore, L.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: A, B, D, G, K, ?.
questions.explanationText: The shifts are +1,+2,+3,+4; the next is +5. K+5=P.

questions.questionText: Find the missing letter: R, P, M, ?, D.
questions.explanationText: Backward shifts increase: -2,-3,-4,-5. Thus M-4=I and I-5=D.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: F, J, O, U, ?.
questions.explanationText: The shifts are +4,+5,+6; next +7. U+7 wraps to B.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: Y, V, R, M, G, ?.
questions.explanationText: Move backward by 3,4,5,6, then 7. G-7 wraps to Z.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: A, C, B, E, C, G, D, ?.
questions.explanationText: Odd positions are A,B,C,D. Even positions are C,E,G,I. Thus the next even term is I.

questions.questionText: Find the missing letter: Z, A, X, C, V, ?, T.
questions.explanationText: Odd positions Z,X,V,T move back by 2. Even positions A,C,E move forward by 2. Hence E.

questions.questionText: Find the next pair: AA, CZ, EY, GX, ?.
questions.explanationText: First letters move forward by 2: A,C,E,G,I. Second letters are A,Z,Y,X,W, moving backward by 1. Hence IW.

questions.questionText: Find the next pair: MN, LO, KP, JQ, ?.
questions.explanationText: First letters decrease by 1 and second letters increase by 1. Thus JQ is followed by IR.

questions.questionText: Find the next group: AZA, BYB, CXC, DWD, ?.
questions.explanationText: Outer letters advance A,B,C,D,E, while the middle retreats Z,Y,X,W,V. Hence EVE.

questions.questionText: Find the missing group: ABC, CDE, ?, GHI.
questions.explanationText: Each group is three consecutive letters, and starting letters advance by 2: A,C,E,G. Thus EFG.

questions.questionText: Find the next pair: AD, EH, IL, MP, ?.
questions.explanationText: Both letters advance by 4 in every step. Therefore, M→Q and P→T, giving QT.

questions.questionText: Find the first pair: ?, DF, GI, JL.
questions.explanationText: Both letters advance by 3 between terms. Moving DF back three positions gives AC.

questions.questionText: Find the next group: XWV, UTS, RQP, ?.
questions.explanationText: Each group contains three descending letters, and every letter moves backward by 3. RQP therefore becomes ONM.

questions.questionText: Find the wrong letter: B, E, J, Q, Y, K.
questions.explanationText: Positions follow n²+1 with wrap-around: 2(B),5(E),10(J),17(Q),26(Z),37→11(K). Therefore, Y is wrong; it should be Z.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: A, E, M, Y, ?.
questions.explanationText: Forward shifts are +4,+8,+12; next +16. Y+16 wraps to O.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: Z, T, L, B, ?.
questions.explanationText: Backward shifts are -6,-8,-10; next -12. B moved back 12 positions wraps to P.

questions.questionText: Find the missing pair: AB, DC, ?, HG, JI.
questions.explanationText: Groups are consecutive pairs with both letters reversed on alternating blocks? The actual sequence AB,DC,FE,HG,JI consists of adjacent pairs, with every pair after the first in descending order except AB. Still FE is uniquely expected by progression of letter sets.

questions.questionText: Find the next pair: ZA, YB, XC, WD, ?.
questions.explanationText: First letters decrease Z,Y,X,W,V while second letters increase A,B,C,D,E. Thus VE.

questions.questionText: Find the next group: AAB, BBC, CCD, DDE, ?.
questions.explanationText: Each term contains two copies of one letter followed by the next letter. After DDE comes EEF.

questions.questionText: Find the missing group: XYZ, UVW, ?, OPQ.
questions.explanationText: Each group has consecutive letters; starting letters move backward by 3: X,U,R,O. Hence RST.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: A, BB, CCC, DDDD, ?.
questions.explanationText: The nth letter is repeated n times: A once, B twice, C three times and D four times. Therefore, E is repeated five times.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: Z, YY, XXX, WWWW, ?.
questions.explanationText: Letters move backward while repetitions rise by one. Hence V appears five times: VVVVV.

questions.questionText: Find the next group: ABZ, CDX, EFV, GHT, ?.
questions.explanationText: The first two letters advance by 2 as consecutive pairs; the third retreats by 2: Z,X,V,T,R. Hence IJR.

questions.questionText: Find the missing group: A1? Ignore the number; choose the letter group continuing AZ, CX, EV, ?.
questions.explanationText: First letters advance by 2 and second letters retreat by 2. Thus EV is followed by GT.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: A1, C3, E5, G7, ?.
questions.explanationText: Letters and numbers both increase by 2. Therefore, G7 is followed by I9.
Numbers increase by 2 and letters advance by 2: 2B,4D,6F,8H,10J.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: Z1, X2, V4, T8, ?.
questions.explanationText: Letters move backward by 2, while numbers double. Thus T8 is followed by R16.

questions.questionText: Find the next group: A2, D4, G8, J16, ?.
questions.explanationText: Letters advance by 3; numbers double. Hence J16→M32.

questions.questionText: Find the missing term: B3, E6, H12, ?, N48.
questions.explanationText: Letters advance by 3 and numbers double. Therefore, the missing term is K24.
Numbers are squares 1,4,9,16,25. Letter shifts are +2,+3,+4,+5: A,C,F,J,O. Hence 25O.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: C9, F18, I27, L36, ?.
questions.explanationText: Letters advance by 3, and numbers increase by 9. Thus L36 is followed by O45.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: A26, C24, E22, G20, ?.
questions.explanationText: Letters advance by 2 while numbers decrease by 2. Hence I18.
Numbers decrease by 3 and letters advance by 3. Therefore, 17J fills the blank.

questions.questionText: Find the next group: A1Z, B2Y, C3X, D4W, ?.
questions.explanationText: The first letter and number increase by 1, while the final letter decreases by 1. Hence E5V.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: Z2A, X4C, V8E, T16G, ?.
questions.explanationText: First letters retreat by 2, numbers double, and final letters advance by 2. Therefore, R32I.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: A2, B6, C12, D20, ?.
questions.explanationText: The letter is the term-position letter. Numbers are n(n+1): 2,6,12,20,30. Thus E30.

questions.questionText: Find the missing term: B4, D16, F36, ?, J100.
questions.explanationText: Letters are even alphabet positions B,D,F,H,J. Numbers are their alphabet positions squared: 2²,4²,... Thus H64.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: C6, F12, I18, L24, ?.
questions.explanationText: Each number is twice the letter position: C=3→6, F=6→12. Letters advance by 3, so O=15 pairs with 30.

questions.questionText: Find the wrong term: A1, C3, E5, G8, I9.
questions.explanationText: Letters and numbers should both be consecutive odd values: A1,C3,E5,G7,I9. Therefore, G8 is wrong; it should be G7.

questions.questionText: Find the correct replacement for H18: B4, D8, F12, H18, J20.
questions.explanationText: Numbers are twice alphabet positions: B=2→4, D=4→8, F=6→12, H=8→16, J=10→20. Thus H18 should be H16.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: A1, B2, D4, G7, K11, ?.
questions.explanationText: Both letter positions and numbers rise by +1,+2,+3,+4; next +5. K(11)+5=P(16), giving P16.

questions.questionText: Find the missing term: Z26, W23, S19, ?, H8.
questions.explanationText: Both components decrease by 3,4,5,6. From S19 subtract 5 to get N14; then subtract 6 to get H8.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: A2, C6, F12, J20, ?.
questions.explanationText: Letter positions are triangular numbers 1,3,6,10,15; numbers are n(n+1):2,6,12,20,30. Position 15 is O, so O30.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: B2, D6, G12, K20, ?.
questions.explanationText: Letter shifts are +2,+3,+4,+5, so K→P. Numbers increase by 4,6,8,10, giving 30. Hence P30.
